title: Tetranuclear Lanthanide Complexes Containing a Hydrazone-type Ligand. Dysprosium [2 × 2] Gridlike Single-Molecule Magnet and Toroic

synthesis.procedure: General procedure: Ln(NO3)3·nH2O (Ln = Gd, 1.0 mmol) in methanol (10 cm3) was added to a hot suspension of H2L (0.46 g, 1.5 mmol) in methanol (10 cm3). The mixture was stirred while heated. The yellow solution was filtered and allowed to stand at room temperature. Yellow crystals suitable for structural analysis formed the next day (yield 37–43% for 1–3).

synthesis.time: crystals formed during the next day
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred heating then filtration and standing crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered yellow solution allowed to stand at room temperature; yellow crystals formed the next day

properties.summary: Static DC magnetism shows μeff/μB = 15.9 at room temperature (calc. 15.9). Weak antiferromagnetic Gd···Gd coupling and small single-ion anisotropy from simultaneous fit of χ(T) and M(B): J = −0.013 cm−1, D = −0.21 cm−1, g = 1.997. DFT gave J = −0.019 cm−1. No AC SMM analysis reported for 1.

properties.summary: Zero-field Dy4 [2×2] SMM and single-molecule toroic. Room-temperature μeff/μB = 20.8 (calc. 21.3). Arrhenius fit of Cole–Cole relaxation times: Ueff = 42.6 K, τ0 = 1.50 × 10−5 s; Orbach+Raman: U = 67.6 K, τ0 = 3.53 × 10−6 s, C = 64.9, n = 1.0. Simplified high-T model gave U = 217–270 K. Weak AF dipolar/exchange coupling (Jex = −0.03 cm−1) produces a net toroidal moment and a nonmagnetic ground state with a field-induced crossing near 0.5 T (experimental dM/dB maximum at 0.43 T; χmol maximum at 2.57 K).
